description: A user-supplied name is joined onto a content directory and opened with no containment check, so '../' escapes the directory. No regex rule covers this; detecting it requires understanding the path data flow.

provenance.cwe_name: Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal')
provenance.selection_rationale: Rank 5 in the 2024 CWE Top 25 and the canonical filesystem access-control flaw; realizable as a self-contained Python program and a semantic (non-pattern) bug that exercises the obscurity axis.
